article.title: Bequest without words of limitation.
article.content: Where property is bequeathed to any person, he is entitled to the whole interest of the testator therein, unless it appears from the will that only a restricted interest was intended for him.
article.html:
95Bequest without words of limitation.

Section 95 · Part VI · Chapter VI · page 36 of the Act

Where property is bequeathed to any person, he is entitled to the whole interest of the testator therein, unless it appears from the will that only a restricted interest was intended for him.
